## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION, not a clean risk-off signal. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (broad strength), while VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) is ABOVE TREND and stocks vs. bonds (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%) is ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; strong breadth conflicts with rising fear and bond outperformance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%) is ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; stocks are also lagging bonds, with SPY/TLT (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Mixed: Dollar Strength (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +1.19%) is → flat, CORRECTION. Yield Curve (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.29%) is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND, while Duration Preference (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +1.42%) is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy and defensives lead: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) is ABOVE TREND, while XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) are ABOVE TREND. XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) is BELOW TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership, with sector breadth strong but the Tech/Financials ratio falling.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US equities are soft: SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) is BELOW TREND. Global relative performance is weak versus the US: EEM (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -7.79%) is BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -4.52% | 1M: -5.64%) is BELOW TREND, while Europe vs. US (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.23%) is ↑ rising, RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Small caps are bouncing but not fully recovered: IWM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%) is RECOVERY. ARKK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -10.59%) is RECOVERY, while IBIT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -3.87%) is BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Oil strength contrasts with precious-metal weakness: BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) is ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -6.40%) and SLV (1W: -5.42% | 1M: -15.45%) are BELOW TREND. Copper remains weak: CPER (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.91%) is BELOW TREND, despite Copper/Gold (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +3.21%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy leadership is confirmed: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) is ABOVE TREND, and BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) is ABOVE TREND. Natural gas is sharply weaker: UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%) is BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED weakness: SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) and XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) are both BELOW TREND; TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming a stocks-versus-bonds divergence. VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) is ABOVE TREND, adding a separate caution signal.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor defensive and energy exposure, with XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to weak technology, with XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND. TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%) is ABOVE TREND; style remains mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If defensive leadership persists, favor XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%), ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: If technology weakness extends, reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%), BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: If oil momentum holds, monitor BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%), ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: If gas weakness continues, watch UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%), BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
Monitor VXX at 18.7200 (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +8.21%), ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD at 0.7419 (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Also track SPY/TLT at 9.3431 (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, and Tech/Financials at 3.2778 (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -8.41%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Energy and defensives show relative strength: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) and XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) are ABOVE TREND. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%), ABOVE TREND, against broad positive sector breadth.
